decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not
later than the expiration of three years beginning with the
date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith (Design and Access Statement, A493/M01, Slimlite Double Glazed Specifications, Slimlite Double Glazed Units, Received 27 September 2011, A493/01A, Received 21 November 2011) and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Details of joinery shall be in accordance with the advice given in Technical Note 3 of the Bedford Park Society's handbook for residents and architects.

Condition : 4 - No development shall take place until samples of the double glazing have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Replacement of existing double glazed french doors, fanlights and side panels to rear outrigger and conservatory with new timber framed sliding folding doors and fanlights, replacement of existing windows to rear outrigger with new double glazed windows and construction of timber framed bicycle shed to front garden
